scope: independent root audit of the all-h 3-adic terminal-term separation for both fixed-j1 boundary phases, the exact-zero classification, the sharpened carrier target, and zero booking

mathematical_audit.parameter_valuations: For 3 not dividing h, every A_h^(0)+j and sigma_h+j has 3-adic valuation -1, while B_h^(0)+j and 3sigma_h+j are 3-integral. Parity also shows none of the relevant rational factors is zero.
mathematical_audit.X_boundary: After division by the nonzero terminal summand T_h, every earlier nonzero term has valuation at least h-t>=1. Hence T_h is uniquely lowest and X_h is nonzero for every admissible h.
mathematical_audit.U_boundary: With n=h+2, division by the terminal summand S_n gives valuation at least n-t>=1 for every earlier nonzero term. Hence U_h is nonzero for every admissible h.
mathematical_audit.classification: Because X_h and U_h are respectively nonzero, neither ordered phase pair can vanish over Q; both exact-zero strata are globally empty.
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: This characteristic-zero theorem does not imply modular nonvanishing at the tied prime. The remaining target is divisibility of nonzero primitive carriers.
mathematical_audit.capacity: Removing an automatic exact-zero mechanism supplies no Chebyshev-mass estimate. The shared fixed-j1 ceiling 1/36 and booking zero remain unchanged.
